title: Bound common-plane growth through four helper directions
body:
On exact #7334/#7113, permit any simultaneous subset of 482 closed interior productive-public groups to add one common two-dimensional plane. The test covers all 1,014 distinct planes containing at least one of four deterministic high-price vectors 365, 244, 327 or 371, with 2,292 incident paid edges. Both exact max-flow engines give directed upper saving zero throughout the declared scope. No timeout. The other 42,421 planes and changed productive endpoints remain untested. **NO VERIFIED GAIN.**

Clean POSIX replay with CPython 3.12: `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-common-plane-growth-bound/replay.py`. It regenerates the seed order, plane list, exact graph and bounds, with independent reverse-inventory and direct-cut certificates. Registered replay, exact commit modes and source history, official read-only Git-free replay and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally.

#7454 supplies the one-vector fixed-endpoint precedent, #7456 the separate endpoint-credit model, and #7334/#7113 the exact word and caller. OpenAI Codex and its subagents materially assisted the proof, implementation and independent verification.
